{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the response rates by arm and severity (to adjust for confounding)
response_by_arm_severity = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().reset_index()
print(response_by_arm_severity)"}
